name: Open Images V7
description: Open Images V7 is a large-scale image dataset with image-level labels, object bounding boxes, instance segmentations, visual relationships, and other annotations. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Kuznetsova, A., et al. (2020). The Open Images Dataset V4: Unified image classification, object detection, and visual relationship detection at scale. International Journal of Computer Vision, 128, 1956–1981. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11263-020-01316-z
